project_type: Astro 7 + React 19 islands catalogue site. Production deploys to Cloudflare Workers via Workers Builds on push to main; a Netlify target (netlify.toml) prerenders the static storefront (dist/client) for a visual preview. Product data is JSON under data/products/ (git = source of truth). Admin edits write drafts to KV and commit canonical JSON to the repo via the GitHub Contents API; images live in R2 (git-ignored) and are served through the Cloudflare /img/** Worker route.
build_system: npm scripts wrapping astro + tsx; wrangler for local Worker/KV/D1/R2 state
test_framework: Vitest (unit + property, `vitest run`) and Playwright (e2e, `playwright test`)
build_command: npm run build  (prebuild: validate:content -> astro build -> postbuild audits: motion budget, emit-redirects, audit-seo, audit-csp, audit-page-budget, audit-image-loading, lint-keyword-density). Needs PUBLIC_SITE_URL env; CI uses http://localhost:4321 as fallback.
test_command: npm test  (vitest run). Targeted regression: npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1) npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts must pass with the REWRITTEN assertions (product now PUBLISHED with 4 images; WhatsApp message still carries name 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set' and '(SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0)'; catalogue filter now includes it; publish gate now passes). 2) npm run check (astro check && tsc --noEmit) => 0 errors. 3) npm test full suite => confirm no NEW failures beyond the known pre-existing baseline failures unrelated to this change (a prior task recorded analytics.snapshot Worker-entry, security.build-output x2, seo.meta, supporting-pages-showroom as failing on the clean base; re-establish the baseline by running on the base commit if in doubt). 4) npm run build must succeed AND emit dist/client/collection/index.html containing the product, and dist/client/product/brown-sofa/index.html. 5) Grep the built output to confirm /collection lists 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set' and /product/brown-sofa exists and contains the exact name and a wa.me link whose decoded text contains 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set (SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0)'. 6) Confirm only ONE product file has sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0 and there is no second sofa with that SKU/id/slug.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by npm run build and git-ignored. dist/client/_redirects is emitted by scripts/emit-redirects.ts. Search index is build-generated. KV/D1/R2 under .wrangler/state/ is git-ignored, local, and disposable. The client search index and prerendered HTML are the storefront; they are rebuilt every build from data/**.
setup_instructions: Node >=22.12.0. npm ci (or npm install) if node_modules missing. Unit tests and the build need no live Cloudflare resources. Do NOT run any --remote wrangler command.
environment_constraints: This environment CANNOT verify the live Netlify/Cloudflare URL as a customer: no confirmed production credentials, and external egress to the live site is not guaranteed. The R2 image originals for this product exist ONLY in local git-ignored R2; they are NOT shipped by a git commit and must be uploaded to production R2 out of band. The coder must NOT attempt to run production wrangler r2 commands; it must GENERATE a script/commands for the user to run. Git identity is not configured in this repo; commits must reuse the existing history identity via per-invocation flags: git -c user.name=Website-Deploys -c user.email=anojmr2008@gmail.com ... Do NOT modify git config.
contribution_requirements: Smallest correct change. The ONLY intended state change to the product is making it Published with its real images. Preserve EXACTLY: id p_322e7n6mth, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, slug brown-sofa, name 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', price 41990, currency INR, category sofas, description/material/tags/seo fields. Do NOT create a second product. Do NOT change the SKU or id. The committed JSON is written with sorted keys, two-space indent, trailing newline (see README GitHub integration 'Deterministic bytes') — match that formatting so the diff is minimal and validate:content passes.
key_patterns: getCatalogue() (src/lib/content/catalogue.ts) is the single public read; it calls filterCatalogue() (src/lib/content/catalogue-filter.ts) which keeps only PUBLIC_STATUSES = ['PUBLISHED','OUT_OF_STOCK'] (src/schemas/product.ts). Both /collection and /product/[slug].astro (getStaticPaths) derive pages from getCatalogue(), so a DRAFT yields NO page at all (a direct visit 404s). The publish gate PublishReadySchema (src/schemas/publish-gate.ts) requires >=1 image, alt text on every image, description >=20, price-or-priceOnEnquiry. ProductSchema invariants (src/schemas/product.ts enforceProductInvariants): (3) published must mirror (status in {PUBLISHED,OUT_OF_STOCK}); OUT_OF_STOCK status <=> OUT_OF_STOCK stock; (5) primaryImage must reference an owned image id; (6) image order must be a contiguous permutation of 0..n-1. Image records: ProductImage schema; R2 original key convention products/{productId}/{imageId}/original.{ext} from src/lib/images/srcset.ts originalKey(); all delivery URLs are derived from productId+imageId, not from the stored key string. The WhatsApp enquiry message is built by buildEnquiryMessage (src/lib/whatsapp.ts) from { kind:'product', productName, sku } + settings.
directory_structure: data/products/*.json = committed source of truth (brown-sofa.json is the target; corner-sofa.json is the OTHER draft and must stay DRAFT). src/lib/content/ = catalogue read + filter. src/pages/collection/index.astro and src/pages/product/[slug].astro = the two public surfaces the user names. src/schemas/ = canonical Zod schemas + publish gate. src/lib/images/ = R2 key/srcset conventions. tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts = the regression anchor pinning this product. .wrangler/state/v3/r2/ngf-media = local git-ignored R2 holding the 4 real originals+derivatives (source for the production upload script).
diagnosis: BROKEN LINK: data/products/brown-sofa.json is committed with status DRAFT / published false / images [], so getCatalogue()'s filterCatalogue() excludes it from EVERY public surface (collection, product page, search, sitemap) => the live storefront shows 0 products. The admin 'Published' state, and the 4 uploaded images, lived only in local KV/R2 working state (.wrangler/state, git-ignored) and were NEVER persisted back to the committed product JSON on GitHub, so Netlify/Cloudflare (which build from the repo) never saw a published product. This is the exact 'admin says Published but 0 live' symptom. The fix is to persist the published state into the committed JSON: add the 4 real image records (with alt text) recovered from local R2, set status PUBLISHED + published true, keeping every verified identity/content field unchanged. Because the publish gate and the existing regression test both currently REQUIRE this product to be an image-less DRAFT, the test must be rewritten to guard the published state instead. Separately, the R2 originals must be uploaded to production R2 (out of band) or the live images would 404.
